evidence: inability to adapt to changes in information technology, including changes to industry accepted delivery models driven by a migration to the internet as a means of service delivery, including any inability to effectively implement new technology-driven products, such as artificial intelligence (AI)
The use of AI technologies by cybercriminals continues to be a major concern, including with respect to deep [fakes]
The development and use of AI presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact the Company's business

AI models, particularly generative AI models, may produce output or take action that is incorrect, that reflects biases included in the data on which they are trained, that results in the release of private, confidential or proprietary information
The legal and regulatory environment relating to AI is uncertain and rapidly evolving and includes regulatory expectations targeted specifically at AI
ai_positioning.summary: INDB adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques de conformité réglementaire, les menaces cybernétiques liées aux technologies IA, et les défis d'implémentation technologique plutôt que sur des opportunités de développement ou d'intégration stratégique.
